name: fields2cover-wheel-deps
description: Slim native deps for the Fields2Cover Python wheel. F2C uses GDAL only as an OGR geometry engine (ogr_geometry.h) + CRS (ogr_spatialref.h / PROJ) and calls the GEOS C API directly (geos_c.h) — it registers NO GDAL format drivers, so we drop GDAL's default features (hdf5, netcdf, postgresql, libkml, openjpeg, ...) and keep only OGR core + PROJ + GEOS. This keeps the bundled closure small enough to relocate into a wheel cleanly (Homebrew's full GDAL closure segfaults when delocated).
